title: Anthropic launches new Claude Fable and Mythos 5.2 models
summary: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 with faster coding and research performance
detailed: Anthropic announced two new AI models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, designed to handle complex technical challenges.
The new models feature improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision, and offer faster output generation than version 5.1.
Claude Fable 5.2 launched immediately for paying users, while Claude Mythos 5.2 is restricted to vetted organizations.
Prerelease testing showed the models successfully completed difficult software migrations, designed electronic devices, and solved physics problems.
sentences: Claude Fable 5.2 is designed to take on big technical challenges, and it’s available today.
Claude Fable 5.2 is designed to take on big technical challenges, and it’s available today.
Anthropic is announcing two new models today: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, which it says are designed to take on “daunting” technical challenges.
The company claims the new models show improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision, and can generate outputs faster than the 5.1 versions of the Fable and Mythos models.
Claude Fable 5.2 is good at challenging software engineering problems, Anthropic says, and can orchestrate agent teams and tackle long-running projects.
The new model has also solved some complex scientific problems, including two open theoretical physics problems.

During prerelease testing, the two models have “helped our engineers complete otherwise-infeasible software migrations, designed three working electronic devices from scratch, solved two open problems in the physics of black holes, made substantial progress on robotics evaluations, and formalized the proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem in 30 hours,” Anthropic says.
As for Claude Mythos 5.2, only vetted organizations will have access to start.
The new 5.2 models follow the release of Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 in September .
